enums.name: BinaryOp
enums.doc: Binary operations (the result is a value).

enums.name: Constant
enums.doc: An entry in the constant pool. Numbers compare bitwise (`0` and `-0` are not merged, `NaN`s can be), so `PartialEq` is hand-written in insn.rs.

variants.name: BigInt
variants.doc: Decimal digit string

enums.name: FunctionKind
enums.doc: Function kind: decides whether it can be `new`ed and whether it can be called directly.

variants.name: Normal
variants.doc: Ordinary function: callable and `new`able

variants.name: Arrow
variants.doc: Arrow function: not `new`able; `this` / `super` come from the enclosing scope

variants.name: Method
variants.doc: Method, accessor, field initializer: not `new`able

variants.name: Constructor
variants.doc: Class constructor: can only be `new`ed; in a derived class `this` waits for `super(...)`

variants.name: Data
variants.doc: Data property (object literal: enumerable; class method: non-enumerable)

enums.name: Insn
enums.doc: An instruction. The accumulator `acc` is an implicit input / output.

accessors.name: target_mut
accessors.doc: Target of a jump instruction (for backpatching): every instruction with a `Label` field counts.

accessors.name: ic_mut
accessors.doc: The inline cache slot of a property access (numbered when assembled): every instruction with an `IcSlot` field counts.

variants.name: LdaConst
variants.doc: acc = constant

variants.name: LdaSmi
variants.doc: acc = small integer (a number exactly representable as i32, no constant pool lookup)

variants.name: Ldar
variants.doc: acc = reg

variants.name: Star
variants.doc: reg = acc

variants.name: LdaGlobal
variants.doc: acc = property of the global object; throws ReferenceError if missing

variants.name: LdaGlobalOrUndefined
variants.doc: Same as above, but gives `undefined` if missing (`typeof x`)

variants.name: StaGlobal
variants.doc: global name = acc (`strict`: throws ReferenceError if undeclared, TypeError if the write fails)

variants.name: LdaEnv
variants.doc: acc = `slot` of the environment `depth` levels out

variants.name: StaEnv
variants.doc: `slot` of the environment `depth` levels out = acc

variants.name: PushEnv
variants.doc: Enter a new environment with `slots` slots

variants.name: PopEnv
variants.doc: Return to the enclosing environment

variants.name: CloneEnv
variants.doc: Replace the current environment with a copy (`for (let …)` gets fresh bindings each iteration)

variants.name: Binary
variants.doc: acc = reg op acc

variants.name: Compare
variants.doc: acc = reg op acc (boolean)

variants.name: BinarySmi
variants.doc: acc = reg op small integer (fused after compilation from `lda.smi n; op reg`)

variants.name: CompareSmi
variants.doc: acc = reg op small integer (boolean; fused after compilation from `lda.smi n; op reg`)

variants.name: BinaryReg
variants.doc: acc = reg op reg2 (fused after compilation from `ldar reg2; op reg`)

variants.name: CompareReg
variants.doc: acc = reg op reg2 (boolean; fused after compilation from `ldar reg2; op reg`)

variants.name: Mov
variants.doc: acc = src, dst = acc (fused after compilation from `ldar src; star dst`)

variants.name: IncReg
variants.doc: acc = reg = ToNumeric(reg) + 1 (fused after compilation from `ldar reg; inc; star reg`)

variants.name: DecReg
variants.doc: acc = reg = ToNumeric(reg) − 1 (fused after compilation from `ldar reg; dec; star reg`)

variants.name: Unary
variants.doc: acc = op acc

variants.name: ToNumeric
variants.doc: acc = ToNumeric(acc) (a number or BigInt; for `++` / `--`)

variants.name: Inc
variants.doc: acc = ToNumeric(acc) + 1 (number or BigInt)

variants.name: Dec
variants.doc: acc = ToNumeric(acc) − 1 (number or BigInt)

variants.name: JumpIfTrue
variants.doc: Jump if ToBoolean(acc) is true

variants.name: JumpIfNotNullish
variants.doc: Jump if acc is not `undefined` / `null` (`??`)

variants.name: JumpIfNullish
variants.doc: Jump if acc is `undefined` / `null` (optional chaining `?.`)

variants.name: JumpIfUndefined
variants.doc: Jump if acc is `undefined`

variants.name: JumpIfNotUndefined
variants.doc: Jump if acc is not `undefined` (default values)

variants.name: CreateRest
variants.doc: acc = array of the arguments from the `n`-th on (rest parameter)

variants.name: ArrayPush
variants.doc: arr.push(acc)

variants.name: ArrayHole
variants.doc: A hole in an array literal: increment arr's length without storing an element

variants.name: ArraySpread
variants.doc: arr.push(...acc)

variants.name: CallSpread
variants.doc: acc = callee.call(this, ...args): the arguments are the array `args`

variants.name: ConstructSpread
variants.doc: acc = new callee(...args)

variants.name: SuperCallSpread
variants.doc: acc = super(...args)

variants.name: CopyData
variants.doc: Define acc's own enumerable properties on obj (object spread)

variants.name: ObjectRest
variants.doc: acc = src's own enumerable properties minus the `count` keys starting at `keys` (object destructuring rest)

variants.name: GetIterator
variants.doc: Get acc's iterator: the iterator goes to `dst`, `next` to `dst+1`, `dst+2` is "done"

variants.name: IteratorNext
variants.doc: Step once: acc = next value; when done, acc = undefined and `iter+2` is set

variants.name: IteratorRest
variants.doc: acc = array of all remaining values

variants.name: IteratorClose
variants.doc: Call the iterator's `return` if it is not done

variants.name: IteratorCloseQuiet
variants.doc: Close the iterator on the throw path: call `return` if not done, discarding its own error (the original exception wins)

variants.name: GetAsyncIterator
variants.doc: Get acc's async iterator (falls back to the sync iterator if there is no `Symbol.asyncIterator`): the iterator goes to `dst`, `next` to `dst+1`, `dst+2` is "done", `dst+3` is "fell back to the sync iterator"

variants.name: IteratorCall
variants.doc: acc = iter.next() (result not inspected; `for await` awaits it next)

variants.name: IteratorResult
variants.doc: acc is an iterator result object: if done, set `iter+2` and acc = undefined, otherwise acc = its value

variants.name: AsyncIteratorReturn
variants.doc: Call the iterator's `return` if not done, acc = its result (awaited next); if done, acc = undefined

variants.name: ForInKeys
variants.doc: acc = acc's enumerable string keys (own first, then along the prototype chain, deduplicated)

variants.name: Yield
variants.doc: Suspend the generator, yielding acc; on resume acc = the value sent in, `mode` = how it was resumed

variants.name: Await
variants.doc: Suspend the async function to await acc; on resume acc = the result, `mode` = how it was resumed

variants.name: DelegateStep
variants.doc: One step of `yield*`: send acc to the inner iterator's next / throw / return according to `mode`, acc = the result object

variants.name: CreateRegExp
variants.doc: acc = regular expression literal /pattern/flags

variants.name: LdaHole
variants.doc: acc = the uninitialized marker (`let` / `const` / `class` bindings hold it on entering the scope)

variants.name: CheckInit
variants.doc: Throw ReferenceError if acc is the uninitialized marker (temporal dead zone)

variants.name: CheckReg
variants.doc: Throw ReferenceError if register `reg` holds the uninitialized marker (checked before assignment)

variants.name: CheckEnv
variants.doc: Throw ReferenceError if `slot` of the environment `depth` levels out is the uninitialized marker

variants.name: CheckThis
variants.doc: Reading `this` before `super()` in a derived class constructor throws ReferenceError

variants.name: DeclareLexical
variants.doc: Declare a top-level `let` / `const` / `class` in the script scope (redeclaration throws SyntaxError), initially uninitialized

variants.name: CheckDeclare
variants.doc: Before a top-level `var` / function declaration, check that it can be declared: a clash with a name in the script scope throws SyntaxError; a function hitting a global property that is non-configurable and not a writable enumerable data property throws TypeError

variants.name: DeclareVar
variants.doc: Declare a top-level `var`: if the global object has no such own property, add one set to undefined (configurable when `deletable`, for eval code)

variants.name: DeclareFunction
variants.doc: Declare a top-level function: the global object's property = acc (an existing non-configurable property only has its value replaced)

variants.name: SetProtoLiteral
variants.doc: `__proto__: acc` in an object literal: if acc is an object or null, set it as obj's prototype; otherwise ignore it

variants.name: CreateNullObject
variants.doc: acc = an empty object with no prototype (a function containing a direct eval keeps eval-declared vars in it)

variants.name: DeclareEvalVar
variants.doc: `var name` in a direct eval: if obj has no such property, add one set to undefined

variants.name: LdaImport
variants.doc: acc = current value of this module's `index`-th import binding (throws ReferenceError if not yet initialized)

variants.name: DynamicImport
variants.doc: acc = import(acc): load, link and evaluate the module, giving a Promise fulfilled with the namespace object; `referrer` is this file's path

variants.name: ImportMeta
variants.doc: acc = this module's import.meta object

variants.name: ToObject
variants.doc: acc = ToObject(acc) (the object of a `with`)

variants.name: WithHas
variants.doc: acc = whether the `with` object obj has name (HasProperty, and not blocked by `Symbol.unscopables`)

variants.name: InitLexical
variants.doc: Initialize a binding in the script scope = acc (allowed once even for `const`)

variants.name: ThrowConstAssign
variants.doc: Assignment to a `const`: throw TypeError

variants.name: CreatePrivateName
variants.doc: acc = a new private name (one per `#x` each time the class is evaluated)

variants.name: GetPrivate
variants.doc: acc = obj.#key (the private name is in acc)

variants.name: SetPrivate
variants.doc: obj.#key = acc

variants.name: DefinePrivate
variants.doc: Define a private member on obj (a field / method / one half of an accessor); the value or accessor function is acc; throws TypeError if it already exists

variants.name: HasPrivate
variants.doc: acc = #key in obj (the private name is in acc)

variants.name: ToPropertyKey
variants.doc: acc = ToPropertyKey(acc) (a string or Symbol; computed field names are evaluated once at class definition)

variants.name: LdaNewTarget
variants.doc: acc = new.target (undefined for a plain call)

variants.name: CreateArguments
variants.doc: acc = this frame's arguments object (all arguments, not linked to the parameters)

variants.name: GetTemplateObject
variants.doc: acc = the template object of tagged template site `site` (the same object every time for the same site): `count` cooked strings starting at `first`, then `count` raw strings

variants.name: CreateClosure
variants.doc: acc = closure of this module's `n`-th function, capturing the current environment

variants.name: CreateMethod
variants.doc: acc = method closure (`super` looks up the prototype of `home`)

variants.name: CreateClass
variants.doc: acc = class constructor (function `func`); `proto` receives its `prototype` object; `parent` is the value of `extends`

variants.name: SetClassFields
variants.doc: The instance field initializer of class constructor `ctor` = acc

variants.name: DefineNamed
variants.doc: Define property `name` on `obj`; the value (or accessor function) is acc

variants.name: DefineKeyed
variants.doc: Same as above, with the key in `key`

variants.name: GetSuper
variants.doc: acc = super.name (a getter's `this` is `this`)

variants.name: GetSuperKeyed
variants.doc: acc = super[acc]

variants.name: SuperCall
variants.doc: acc = super(args…): construct the parent class, initialize `this`, run instance field initializers

variants.name: SuperCallForward
variants.doc: Default derived constructor: `super(...arguments)` with the arguments passed through unchanged

variants.name: Construct
variants.doc: acc = new callee(args…)

variants.name: InstanceOf
variants.doc: acc = reg instanceof acc

variants.name: In
variants.doc: acc = reg in acc

variants.name: DeleteNamed
variants.doc: acc = delete obj.name

variants.name: DeleteKeyed
variants.doc: acc = delete obj[acc]

variants.name: CreateObject
variants.doc: acc = {}, with slots reserved for `capacity` properties (the number of properties in the literal)

variants.name: CreateArray
variants.doc: acc = [first, first+1, …] (`count` of them)

variants.name: GetNamed
variants.doc: acc = obj.name

variants.name: SetNamed
variants.doc: obj.name = acc (`strict`: throws TypeError if the write fails)

variants.name: GetKeyed
variants.doc: acc = obj[acc]

variants.name: SetKeyed
variants.doc: obj[key] = acc (`strict`: throws TypeError if the write fails)

variants.name: CallEval
variants.doc: `eval(…)`: if callee is %eval%, run it as a direct eval (the visible bindings are this function's scope table `scope`), otherwise same as Call

variants.name: Call
variants.doc: acc = callee.call(this, args…): `argc` consecutive registers starting at `args`

variants.name: PushHandler
variants.doc: Install an exception handler: on throw, jump to `Label` (acc is the exception value) with the environment restored to the one at install time

variants.name: PopHandler
variants.doc: Remove the most recently installed handler

variants.name: Throw
variants.doc: Throw acc

variants.name: Return
variants.doc: Return acc

structs.name: Reg
structs.doc: Register: a slot in the function frame. Calling convention: `r0` is `this`, `r1` is the callee itself, parameters start at `r2`.

structs.name: Label
structs.doc: Jump target: in a `Draft` an instruction index, in `Function::code` a byte offset (assembling rewrites it).

structs.name: IcSlot
structs.doc: Inline cache slot of a property access, numbered from 0 in each function when assembled.

structs.name: EvalName
structs.doc: A binding visible at a direct eval: name, slot in its environment, whether it is `const`, whether it needs a TDZ check.

fields.name: self_name
fields.doc: The own name of a named function expression: assignment is silently ignored in sloppy mode, throws TypeError in strict mode

structs.name: EvalScope
structs.doc: The scope table at a direct eval: innermost first, one level per environment on the environment chain.

structs.name: Draft
structs.doc: Instructions being compiled: jump targets are instruction indices. `Draft::fuse`, then `Box::<[u8]>::from(draft)` assembles them into `Function::code`.

structs.name: Function
structs.doc: A function: name, parameter count, register count, instructions, constant pool.

fields.name: keeps_args
fields.doc: Keep all arguments in the frame on entry (for default derived constructors and rest parameters)

fields.name: generator
fields.doc: Generator function: a call does not run it, it returns a generator

fields.name: asynchronous
fields.doc: async function: a call runs it up to the first `await` and returns a Promise

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: Strict mode: `this` is not replaced by the global object, failed assignments / deletes throw

fields.name: length
fields.doc: The function's `length`: the number of parameters before the first one with a default value (or the rest parameter)

fields.name: code
fields.doc: The instructions, assembled from a `Draft`: each is a one-byte opcode then fixed-width little-endian operands; jump targets are byte offsets

fields.name: scopes
fields.doc: Scope tables of every direct eval in the function (the `scope` of `CallEval` indexes this)

fields.name: mapped_params
fields.doc: Mapped arguments: the parameter environment slot for the i-th argument (only for sloppy mode with simple parameters)

structs.name: Module
structs.doc: All functions compiled from one script; function 0 is the script itself.

consts.name: MAIN
consts.doc: Index of the script itself in the module

consts.name: MAGIC
consts.doc: First bytes of the binary form (a leading NUL never starts JS text)
